title: Madras High Court halts Foxconn subsidiary project work till June 29 amid pending dispute with BNR
description: The Madras High Court has halted certain works related to a project of Foxconn’s Tamil Nadu unit Yuzhan Technology India, amid a pending contract dispute with BNR Infrastructure Projects [BNR Infrastructure v. Yuzhan Technology]BNR and Yuzhan had entered into an agreement on October 29, 2025 after which a letter of award was issued by Yuzhan in favour of BNR.
